candidates.statement: Postgres connection pool exhaustion on the order service: save_order spans show pool size 5 with 0 idle connections and fail with DependencyUnavailable, causing order POST /v1/orders to return 503 and gateway checkout to return 502 after ~2s.
candidates.uncertainty: No postgres server-side metrics or logs; pool exhaustion inferred from client pool attributes (size 5, idle 0) across three traces.

report.explanation: All three checkout traces show the same pattern: inventory and payment succeed, then postgres.save_order fails with DependencyUnavailable while the client pool reports size 5 and idle 0, and order returns 503, surfacing as gateway 502 with ~2s latency. This bounds the fault to order-service postgres connection pool exhaustion.
